name: 4274-stripped-tests

stats() reports how many topics that reached a productive status were proposed after the current oldest queued topic, derived only from registry rows, so 'the head has been passed over' is a number in the payload rather than an inference — tests/test_research_store.py

next() claims a queued topic that has waited at least 14 days ahead of any topic that has waited less than that, whatever the stored priority, so a 50-day-old prio-55 row is claimed ahead of a prio-50 row proposed today — tests/test_research_store.py
